northern_leaf_blight.symptoms_summary: Long, narrow, gray-green to tan lesions unrestricted by leaf veins.
cultural_control: Spray disease medicine when you first see lung gray spots on leaves
Burn or bury old infected plants after harvest

fungicide.note: Ask your local agro-dealer for disease medicine containing one of these: mancozeb, azoxystrobin, or propiconazole.

low.message: Spray disease medicine now — early treatment works best

moderate.message: Spray disease medicine as soon as possible. Check plants again in a few days

high.message: Disease medicine gives limited results at this stage. Focus on stopping spread to healthy plants and use resistant varieties next season

northern_leaf_blight.timing_window: Most effective from tasseling to early grain formation.

gray_leaf_spot.symptoms_summary: Rectangular tan-to-gray lesions with sharp parallel edges, following leaf veins.
cultural_control: Spray disease medicine when you first see rectangular gray spots
Plant resistant maize varieties next season
Don't plant maize on the same field continuously

fungicide.note: Ask your local agro-dealer for disease medicine containing one of these: mancozeb, azoxystrobin, or propiconazole.

low.message: Spray disease medicine now — treating early gives best results

moderate.message: Spray disease medicine soon. Disease spreads quickly in humid weather — check plants again in a few days

high.message: Heavy infection can damage the whole plant. Disease medicine is less effective now — focus on stopping spread and use resistant varieties next season

gray_leaf_spot.timing_window: Most effective from tasseling to early grain formation.

common_rust.symptoms_summary: Cinnamon-brown, oval pustules on both leaf surfaces; rupture to release powdery spores.
cultural_control: Remove sick leaves if you see rust spots
Plant rust-resistant maize varieties next season
Rust often gets better in hot, dry weather — watch before treating

fungicide.note: Disease medicine is rarely needed for common rust — mainly for severe cases. Ask your agro-dealer if unsure.

low.message: Usually no treatment needed. Continue checking weekly

moderate.message: Spray disease medicine only if rust spots are still few per leaf. Rust is often not worth treating

high.message: Check tassels and ears for spread. Disease medicine has limited benefit now — focus on resistant varieties for next season

common_rust.timing_window: Most effective when rust spots are still few per leaf.

healthy.symptoms_summary: Leaf shows no visible signs of disease.
cultural_control: Continue normal fertilizer and watering schedule
Keep checking weekly, especially after rain
Your maize looks healthy — keep up the good work!

fungicide.note: No medicine needed — your plant is healthy.

healthy.ui_notes: Use neutral/green tone, not red/orange urgency colors. No 'Call AEO' button needed — show 'Scan Again Next Week' reminder instead.

confidence_display_rule: Always show confidence % alongside detected disease. If confidence is below 70%, show caution: 'Result uncertain — try scanning again in better light or ask your AEO to confirm.'
disclaimer: Disease medicine recommendations are general guidance. Always check with your local agro-input dealer before buying and follow product label instructions.
